description: `cli-health reindex` rebuilds the search index on demand; a 5-minute background sync loop keeps the index current without manual intervention.

requirements.description: The `cli-health reindex` command must rebuild the Qdrant search index from all discoverable scenario manifests and `--help` fallback parsers. It must support: (a) `--wait` flag to block until indexing completes and report the final count of indexed commands; (b) `--dry-run` flag to preview which commands would be indexed without writing to Qdrant; (c) `--scenario <name>` flag to scope reindex to a single scenario. The command must not re-embed documents whose content has not changed since the last index run (no spurious re-embedding on no-op rebuild).
requirements.title: On-Demand Reindex with --wait and --dry-run Support

validation.notes: Given --dry-run, no Qdrant write operations are invoked and discovered commands are printed to stdout
Given --scenario cli-health, only commands from the cli-health manifest are processed
Given a document whose embedding hash matches the stored hash, the embedder is not invoked for that document
Given --wait flag, the command blocks until all embedding operations complete before exiting
Reconcile test: run reindex twice with no manifest changes between runs; assert the second run produces zero Ollama embed calls (no spurious re-embedding)
Run reindex --scenario cli-health --wait; assert only cli-health commands appear in the Qdrant collection delta and final count is reported
Run reindex --dry-run; assert Qdrant collection point count is unchanged after the command exits
On-demand reindex ensures the search index reflects the current state of manifests after deployment or development changes

requirements.description: The `cli-health` service must run a background goroutine (or equivalent async loop) that automatically triggers a reindex scan every 5 minutes without manual intervention. The sync loop must apply the same no-spurious-re-embedding optimization as on-demand reindex. The loop must be active whenever the `cli-health` server process is running and must log each sync cycle start, completion, and count of newly indexed or updated commands.
requirements.title: Automated 5-Minute Background Sync Loop

validation.notes: Given a mock timer firing at the configured interval, the sync loop invokes the reindex service method exactly once per tick
Given no manifest changes between ticks, the sync loop produces zero embed calls
Given a new command added to a manifest between ticks, the next sync loop tick indexes that command
Start the cli-health server, modify a manifest, wait up to 5 minutes plus buffer; assert the new command appears in search results without manual reindex
Confirm sync loop log entries are emitted at each cycle with correct counts
Teams do not need to remember to run reindex after manifest changes; the index stays current automatically

title: On-demand and scheduled reindexing
